subject: Re: Project Nimbus kickoff: language-to-policy-code demo plan
body:
Hi Ulla,

Staffing: Freya Ruiz at 50% as research lead, Maren Zhou at 40% on the control-primitive API layer, Halima Toure at 30% on perception integration. Tight but workable for the 4/27 target.

Compute is modest — this is prompting-heavy, not training-heavy. I've asked for 32 A100s best-effort on titan-a100 for sim rollouts and eval batches. No vulcan or cirrus ask this half.

Two dependencies to flag: we need a Shipyard demo slot for the LRB session, and the hierarchical code-gen prompts (recursively generating undefined helper functions) need a stable model endpoint — Freya will pin a version this week so evals stay comparable.

If the LRB date slips past early May we lose the robot lab booking, so let's hold 4/27 firm.

Jelena
